title: Earnings Gap
briefing: Orchard Foods reports on day 12 after a nervous slide. Newsy Nina will jump on the headline. Read it carefully: what matters is the surprise and the guidance.
objective: Trade the earnings surprise and guidance, not the nerves before it.
debrief: Orchard Foods slid before its report as nervous holders sold. On day 12 it beat estimates and raised guidance: the price gapped up and kept drifting higher for a week, helped by analyst upgrades on day 15. On day 22 a discount rival announced 40 new stores, and the shares turned lower for the rest of the match. A disciplined player stayed small before the report, bought after the beat-and-raise and sold when the competitive threat appeared.
